'''Hanna Maaret Halmeenpää''' (born 7 March 1976) is a Finnish politician, representing the [[Green League]] in the [[Parliament of Finland]] since 2015.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eduskunta.fi/FI/kansanedustajat/Sivut/1324.aspx|title=Kansanedustajat: Hanna Halmeenpää|publisher=Parliament of Finland|access-date=14 October 2018}}</ref> She was elected to the Parliament from the [[Oulu (constituency)|Oulu]] constituency in [[2015 Finnish parliamentary election|2015]] with 4,860 votes.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://tulospalvelu.vaalit.fi/E-2015/fi/val12.html|title=Valitut ehdokkaat: Oulun vaalipiiri|publisher=Ministry of Justice|date=2 June 2017|access-date=14 October 2018}}</ref>

Halmenpää has also served in the City Council of [[Kalajoki]] since 2008. In 2012 municipal elections she got the most votes in the city.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.kp24.fi/uutiset/320137/Hanna-Halmeenp%C3%A4%C3%A4-Kalajoen-%C3%A4%C3%A4nikuningatar|title=Hanna Halmeenpää Kalajoen äänikuningatar|work=Keskipohjanmaa|date=28 October 2012 |access-date=14 October 2018}}</ref>
